scope: current suite software HIP vLLM real Qwen64K and full TIGRE head64; not end-to-end inference or cross-device best

vllm.strategy: 32 eight-leaf instances; 224 merges; per-instance adjacent LLVM24 greedy, leftmost tie; cleanup none; shared copysign
vllm.timing: GPU event; sum of six group/layer medians; 3 warmups,15 measured,3 rotated batches

tigre.strategy: structural LLVM24 greedy; scoped-local; 2 merges: Y+Z then X+(Y,Z); 1 sample call
tigre.timing: GPU event; sum of six group/layer medians; 3 warmups,15 measured,3 rotated batches
